nonclaims: No lane producer is registered receipt-backed and none is on an acceptance path (an implemented, unregistered wave-B asset-transfer producer exists); the only accepted certificate is the registered-empty certificate over an all-lanes-disabled state, and the two registered-empty producers certify emptiness from the committed root alone (no lane state bytes are read).
The checker is not mounted in any verifier, commit port, or route; it grants evidence-only authority.

The Lean model is bounded and proves nothing about finite-width arithmetic, canonical bytes, roots, or the running implementation; the ESSO model is bounded and inductive only; neither proves finite-width arithmetic, canonical bytes, roots, or the running implementation.
